Discord bridge

Relays the Discord RPC named pipe from inside a bottle to the Discord client on the host, so that a Windows game's rich presence reaches Discord on macOS.

make install builds GmacDiscordBridge.exe and places it in GmacKit/Sources/GmacKit/Discord/Resources/, from which it ships as a bundle resource. The built binary is committed, because Xcode builds do not run make and CI has no MinGW toolchain. Rebuild and commit the binary whenever bridge.c changes.

brew install mingw-w64   # provides x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc
make install

Design

Both ends of the Discord RPC transport use the same framing, a little-endian opcode and length followed by JSON, so the relay forwards bytes without parsing messages. It serves \\.\pipe\discord-ipc-0 inside the prefix and relays bytes to whichever of discord-ipc-0 to discord-ipc-9 exists in the socket directory it is given.

Three constraints apply to any change:

  • The socket is reached through raw xnu system calls. PE code shares an address space with the Unix side of Wine, so a syscall instruction enters the kernel directly. A PE module cannot link libSystem, and the supported alternative, a PE plus a unixlib half, would have to be built against a specific Wine build rather than plain MinGW. sockaddr_un here follows xnu's layout (a length byte followed by a family byte), not Linux's 16-bit family field.
  • The socket directory is passed with --dir. A PE process sees Wine's Windows environment, in which the host's TMPDIR may not have survived, and the sockets are named relative to that directory.
  • The relay becomes a Wine system process after a grace period. System processes do not keep a prefix alive, so the relay stops holding a bottle open once the game exits and terminates with the prefix rather than outliving it. The grace period exists because Gmac starts the relay immediately before the game, and a prefix containing no ordinary process begins shutting down.

Manual test

Serve a socket at a path short enough to fit sun_path, point the relay at it, and connect from inside the prefix:

mkdir -p /tmp/gmacipc
python3 - /tmp/gmacipc/discord-ipc-0 <<'EOF'
import socket, struct, sys
server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
server.bind(sys.argv[1]); server.listen(1)
conn, _ = server.accept()
header = conn.recv(8)
print(struct.unpack("<II", header), conn.recv(4096))
EOF

WINEPREFIX=... wine64 GmacDiscordBridge.exe --dir /tmp/gmacipc --grace 600000

--grace is specified in milliseconds. A large value prevents the relay from standing down while it is being tested.
